name: Screening
description: Ensure background verification checks are carried out for employees in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

compliant_if.detail: Employee records are present and contain screening or onboarding data.

partial_if.detail: Employee records exist but no screening-specific evidence is documented.

missing_if.detail: No employee records uploaded to verify screening procedures.

remediation: Implement pre-employment background screening procedures for all employees and document results.

name: Terms and Conditions of Employment
description: Ensure employees understand and agree to information security responsibilities as part of their employment terms.

compliant_if.detail: Employee records and governance activities confirm employment terms include security responsibilities.

partial_if.detail: Employee records exist but no governance evidence confirms security terms in employment contracts.

missing_if.detail: No employee records uploaded to verify employment terms.

remediation: Include information security responsibilities in all employment contracts and terms of engagement.

name: Information Security Awareness, Education and Training
description: Ensure employees receive appropriate information security awareness, education, and training.

compliant_if.detail: Employee records show security training coverage of at least 60%.

partial_if.detail: Training records exist but coverage is below the 60% threshold.

missing_if.detail: No employee or training records uploaded to verify awareness programme.

remediation: Implement a mandatory security awareness training programme for all employees with tracked completion.

name: Disciplinary Process
description: Ensure a formal disciplinary process exists to address violations of information security policies.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records confirm a disciplinary process is documented.

partial_if.detail: Employee records exist but no formal disciplinary process is documented in governance.

missing_if.detail: No governance or employee records to verify disciplinary process.

remediation: Document a formal disciplinary process for information security policy violations.

name: Responsibilities after Termination or Change of Employment
description: Ensure information security responsibilities remain defined after termination or change of employment.

compliant_if.detail: Employee and governance records confirm post-employment security responsibilities are defined.

partial_if.detail: Employee records exist but no formal post-employment security procedures documented.

missing_if.detail: No employee records uploaded to verify post-employment controls.

remediation: Define post-employment security responsibilities including access revocation and NDA continuation.

name: Confidentiality or Non-Disclosure Agreements
description: Ensure confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements are in place to protect organizational information.

compliant_if.detail: Employee and vendor records confirm NDA/confidentiality agreements are tracked.

partial_if.detail: Partial records exist but NDAs are not confirmed across both employees and vendors.

missing_if.detail: No employee or vendor records uploaded to verify NDA status.

remediation: Require signed NDAs from all employees, contractors, and third-party vendors before granting access.

name: Remote Working
description: Ensure security measures are implemented to protect information during remote working.

compliant_if.detail: Network rules and governance records confirm remote working security controls are in place.

partial_if.detail: Some evidence exists but remote working security is not fully documented across network and governance.

missing_if.detail: No network or governance records uploaded to verify remote working controls.

remediation: Define a Remote Working Security Policy covering VPN, endpoint protection, and secure data handling.

name: Information Security Event Reporting
description: Ensure employees are aware of and follow procedures for reporting information security events.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records confirm security event reporting procedures are documented.

partial_if.detail: Risk register exists but no formal event reporting procedure documented in governance.

missing_if.detail: No governance or risk register uploaded to verify event reporting procedures.

remediation: Document security event reporting procedures and train employees on when and how to report incidents.
